productContext.businessDomain: Novelty group-decision / random picker web app
productContext.manualDescription: 2FS (Two Factor Sorteo) is a whimsical, single-page two-factor raffle web app that picks one person out of a group of 2-10 people. Flow is three linear steps: (1) El Rebano - add between 2 and 10 names; (2) La Rueda - a drag-to-spin roulette wheel that selects one name, with a fallback spin button and an escape hatch to resolve with rock-paper-scissors; (3) El Oraculo - a magic-8-ball shaken by dragging (with a shake-for-me fallback) that answers yes / no / maybe about the selected name. Yes confirms the pick with an official stamp. No drops that name from the pool and returns the user to the wheel. Maybe means shake again. The UI wears a heavy editorial gospel/oracle theme in Spanish (participants are corderos, the pool is el rebano, the questions are plegarias). It is a novelty group-decision tool for deciding who does a chore, who wins a giveaway, who pays. Spanish by default with an English toggle.
productContext.knownPrimaryUsers: Group organizers, practical deciders, casual groups deciding chores, giveaways, or who pays
productContext.knownWorkflows: Add 2-10 names; spin the wheel to select one; consult the 8-ball for yes/no/maybe; confirm the winner, or drop the rejected name and retry from the wheel
productContext.knownRiskAreas: A pick that seems final can be reversed when the 8-ball says no and the flow returns to selection, so progress can feel undone; the whimsical theming can obscure functional state and the meaning of maybe/no outcomes
productContext.aiSummary: 2FS (Two Factor Sorteo) is a whimsical single-page two-factor raffle app that picks one person from a group of 2-10 across three linear steps (add names, spin a drag-to-spin wheel, shake a magic-8-ball that answers yes/no/maybe). Yes confirms with a stamp; no drops the name and returns to the wheel; maybe shakes again. Heavily themed editorial oracle UI in Spanish with an English toggle; a novelty group-decision tool.
